name: Gemini Client
description: Fabric utility / sandbox client for Minecraft 26.2 with 269 modules, glassmorphic ClickGUI, draggable HUD, VersionBridge mechanics, and built-in Baritone 3D A* pathfinding.

custom.gemini:baritone: Hooks baritone.api.BaritoneAPI when present and ships a built-in 3D A* engine (#goto, #mine, #follow, #tunnel, #farm, #explore, #excavate, #sel, #thisway, #axis).
custom.gemini:versions: VersionBridge adapts combat and world rules across version profiles; GeminiMixinPlugin soft-loads version-sensitive mixins.
